name: Password Sign-In Locked Out
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits password credentials for an account that is currently locked out, and receives a lockout-specific outcome without establishing a session.
finalOutcome: No authenticated session is established and the user reaches a lockout-specific recovery surface without exposing additional security details.

sourceReferences.note: SignInResult.IsLockedOut returns AUTH030 and records PasswordAuthenticationFailed without establishing a session.
Integration coverage includes the lockout-specific server path and canonical transition evidence.
Canonical Account Locked surface is defined, but web and mobile implementations remain planned.
Server implementation is reconciled, but behavior implementation remains needs-review until the Account Locked surface is implemented on web and mobile.
